description_en: Retrieves the list of GPU cluster alerts
name: GetGpuClusterListAlarmRecord

parameters.help_en: Query by a specific point in time, such as "2025-08-22 18:16:25". Query by a time range using the "start,end" format, such as "2025-08-22 18:16:25,2025-08-23 18:16:25"
parameters.name: alarm_time

parameters.help_en: Query by a specific cluster, such as "cluster1". To query multiple clusters, separate them with commas: "cluster1,cluster2,cluster3"
parameters.help_zh: 指定集群查询，如："cluster1"，如查询多个集群用 逗号分隔:"cluster1,cluster2,cluster3"
parameters.name: alarm_cluster

parameters.help_en: Query by a specific task, such as "task1". To query multiple tasks, separate them with commas: "task1,task2,task3"
parameters.help_zh: 指定任务查询，如："task1"，如ch查询多个任务用 逗号分隔:"task1,task2,task3
parameters.name: alarm_task

parameters.help_en: The current page number for pagination
parameters.name: current

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page for pagination
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: Filter by task status, such as blocking, running, exited, or restart
parameters.name: status

parameters.help_en: Filter by anomaly type, such as GPU memory access out-of-bounds or task hang
parameters.help_zh: 过滤指定异常类型，如显存访问越界、任务HANG
parameters.name: alarm_type

parameters.help_en: Filter anomalies by instance ID or container
parameters.help_zh: 按照instance id、容器过滤异常
parameters.name: alarm_ext_info

alarmCluster.description_en: The cluster where the alert was triggered

alarmExtInfo.description_en: The additional information about the alert

alarmId.description_en: The unique ID of the alert

alarmLog.description_en: The event log associated with the alert

alarmTask.description_en: The ID of the task where the anomaly occurred

alarmTime.description_en: The date and time when the alert was triggered

uid.description_en: The UUID of the cloud account

message.description_en: When code is not "Success", message contains the error information

total.description_en: The total number of returned records
